note: Unquoted: sentences reporting what a requirement SAYS with no quote to check, as file:id signatures rather than a count -- a count cannot name which one is new. Existence: Lean docstring quotes found in no document or ADR, keyed on file:norm(quote), each with its own reason; a real misquote is fixed, never entered here.
